reports.title: Reports to review
reports.sub: Jobs people reported and jobs with scam signs, the mainland site's shared referral codes, and personal-data requests.
reports.reportSummary: {count, plural, one {# report} other {# reports}} · first {first} · latest {last}
reports.signalsTitle: Scam signs found in the post (rule-based, with the sentence they rest on):

signal.intl_messaging_app_only: Contact only through a messaging app.

reports.reviewElsewhere: Decide this one on Suspicious jobs
reports.decisionHelp: Close takes the job out of every list. Keep reopens a job closed by reports and clears its scam signs. For now, one new report can close a kept job again; it then comes back to this list. Both are recorded with your name.
reports.decisionHelpHolds: Close takes the job out of every list. Keep reopens a job closed by reports and clears its scam signs; only reports made after your decision count toward closing it again, and it comes back to this list when one arrives. Both are recorded with your name.

referrals.title: Shared referral codes
referrals.sub: Codes people shared on the mainland site. A code shows only after someone here approves it. Reject paid or traded codes and codes with contact details.

privacy.title: Personal-data requests
privacy.sub: Requests to see, copy, correct or delete personal data, or to withdraw consent. Answer before the due date.
privacy.dueRule: Due dates: 15 working days on the mainland site, 30 days on the international site. Showing {count}.

overrides.title: Changes for this person only
overrides.sub: Raise or lower one credit limit, set an entitlement, or turn a beta feature on for this person. Every change is recorded with your name and reason.
overrides.failed: That didn't save. Check the name and value and try again.
overrides.name: Name
overrides.invalid: Fill in the name, a value (a whole number, true or false) and a reason.
overrides.help: Credit limits take a whole number per day or week. Entitlements take a number or true/false. Beta features take true or false.

refund.title: Refund check
refund.sub: What the published refund rules say about this person's latest charge. This is a check only: refunds are issued in the payment provider.
refund.issueElsewhere: Issue the refund in the payment provider, then note it on the person's record.

audit.title: Admin actions
audit.sub: Changes admins made: per-person limits, decisions on reported jobs, referral-code checks and retried background work. Newest first. Each row is written when the action happens and is kept even if an account is deleted.
audit.adminPage: Open the admin page of account {id}
audit.aboutPage: Open the admin page of account {id}

action.admin_override_created: Added a limit or feature for one person
action.admin_override_deleted: Removed a limit or feature for one person
action.admin_invite_reward_reviewed: Approved or rejected a held invite reward

inviteRewards.title: Held invite rewards
inviteRewards.sub: When someone signs up with a friend's invite link and the sign-up looks like the same person, or the check could not run, the practice credits wait here for a person to decide.
inviteRewards.listSub: Oldest first. Only this site's invites are listed.
inviteRewards.qualified: Met the conditions for the reward on {date}
inviteRewards.notQualified: Has not met the conditions for the reward yet
inviteRewards.noReasons: No reason was recorded for this hold.

reason.same_ip: Same network address as the inviter
reason.burst: Many sign-ups from this invite link in a short time
reason.signals_missing: No device or network record for one of the two accounts
reason.signals_unavailable: The device and network check could not run
reason.invitee_no_profile: The friend's account has no profile

inviteRewards.help: Approve gives the practice credits that are due: one for the friend, and one for the inviter unless they have reached this year's limit for invite rewards. Reject means the invite does not count and no credits are given. Neither can be undone here. This page prints no names, emails or account ids; the two links open the accounts' admin pages.

outcome.approved: Approved. Both people got their practice credits.
outcome.approved_friend_only: Approved. The friend got their practice credit. The inviter got none: they have reached this year's limit for invite rewards, or their account has no profile.
outcome.approved_pending: Approved. The credits could not be added yet; they are retried automatically.
outcome.not_counted: This invite does not count and no credits were given: the friend's account has no profile, or someone rejected the invite first.
outcome.rejected: Rejected. This invite does not count.
outcome.already_reviewed: Someone already reviewed this invite. Nothing changed.
